scope: Local snapshot-enable replication, actual pilot-core synthesis and public functional comparison. Full receiver physical qualification and deployment remain incomplete.

implementation.source_token_check: Only split the existing declaration and add the local synthesis attribute/comments; all executable RTL tokens otherwise match baseline 84a1a358.
implementation.motivation: The preceding final routed receiver measured fanout 649, wire delay 12.649 ns and slack -3.384 ns on this same-clock pilot snapshot-enable net.
implementation.tradeoff: Replication reduces local fanout but increases registers, LUT primitives and control sets. Full placement and timing must decide whether it helps this nearly full receiver.

isolated_synthesis.configuration: Actual complete pilot capture/DDC, fixed 15 MS/s profile, full flattening, AreaOptimized_high, control_set_opt_threshold=4. Synthetic 10 ns clock and 0 ns I/O only in this isolated probe.

actual_netlist_comparison.comparison: Two actual synthesized full pilot cores with vendor primitive models; cycle-by-cycle public control, valid AXI data and promised AXIS data equality. No internal signal forcing.
actual_netlist_comparison.adapters: Unique names for the retained pacer submodules; one byte-identical global-startup definition. Reversing the name-only adapters reconstructs each original netlist exactly.

workloads: snapshots while real DDC data continues
invalid active CLEAR retains a fault
high source-counter bits and reset epoch
functional_evidence.bench_development: The initial stall assertion wrongly checked the FIFO output after a newly-ready consumer could advance it. It now checks the promised beat before the consuming edge. Explicit reduction-X checks reject unknown public controls and valid data; the final v2 netlist run includes them. Earlier evidence is retained.
functional_evidence.limits: Finite tested workloads, not formal equivalence or full-receiver timing, ADC, DMA, native IIO or RF proof. RTL and netlist simulations are separate comparisons, not a cross-simulator trace-equality claim.

new_full_receiver.launch_conditions: Clean pinned HDL, fresh project, no reference.dcp, global synthesis, identical 15 MS/s paired/shared-realtime/boundary-stop profile and constraints.
